text:
Ben: Heads-up: candidate promote hit failures in post-deploy smoke — LP service 500s. Holding cut.

deploybot: deploybot/promote-job-2026 attempt #1 failed: smoke-check failed (service LP returned 500). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/promote/7890 :rotating_light:

Katie: Any artifact errors in the job logs or just runtime 500s?

Ben: There's an artifact layer checksum mismatch earlier in the task when unpacking vendor assets: expected sha256=9f7e... got 1a2b... then a retry of the extractor succeeded, but afterwards smoke reports LP 500.

Arjun: That's worrying. Could be malformed asset causing runtime crash on some instances. We need to decide: rollback to last-prod digest, or partial promote with a hotfix. Change window closes in ~30m.

release-bot: Change window: open until 2026-10-15T16:00Z.

Katie: Quick sanity checks: 1) Was there any schema/db migration? 2) Are canary instances behind a different blobstore endpoint?

Ben: No DB migrations. Canary + main both use same blobstore. Canary logs show repeated S3 500s during GET of assets/vendor-bundle.tar.gz.

Arjun: Option A: emergency pin -> force-promote previous digest sha256:9f7eabcde (fastest, known-good). Option B: attempt reupload of vendor-bundle from CI artifacts and re-run promotes (slower, could succeed). I'm leaning A to avoid partial failure during traffic ramp.

Katie: I agree pinning is safer given short window. We should record the rollback reason and create a follow-up to reattempt with verified upload.

Ben: Preparing pin command. Will also add note to release notes and open a ticket.

Ben: Running force-promote now:
```bash
# force promote to last-good digest
ci-promote --env prod --artifact-digest sha256:9f7eabcde --reason "emergency rollback: vendor-bundle checksum mismatch during promote" --actor ben
```

deploybot: Force promote requested by Ben. Executing promote: deploybot/promote-job-2026-force (dry-run=false).

deploybot: Promote completed. New active digest: sha256:9f7eabcde. Traffic switched back to last-known-good.

Arjun: Confirming service LP back to healthy on all pods. :white_check_mark:

Katie: Filing ticket ENG-5234: "Investigate artifact checksum mismatch and intermittent blobstore 500s during promote". Assigning to eng-infra + eng-sre. Include: artifact id 2026, failing object vendor-bundle.tar.gz, CI artifact url, and affected hosts.

Ben: Added short note to release_changelog.md:
```
2026-10-15: Emergency rollback to sha256:9f7eabcde due to checksum mismatch during promote; traffic restored. Follow-up ticket ENG-5234 opened to investigate blobstore 500s and CI reupload policy.
```

release-bot: Release notes updated and PMs notified in #product.

Arjun: Next steps: schedule a safe re-promote in next change window after we validate artifact upload. Prefer reupload via the CI canonical artifact store and a full verify step (sha256 compare + smoke).

Katie: Also adding a short checklist to release runbook: verify artifact digest in blobstore, validate multipart upload completion, run `s3cmd head` to check ETag, and run CI verify step before promote.

oncall-bot: Reminder: if a re-promote is scheduled, coordinate with eng-sre for rolling safety checks.

Ben: Thanks all. Closing this thread; ENG-5234 will track root cause. I'll post the re-promote timeline once infra confirms reupload and verification.
